name: TX-17
label: Likely R

key_factors: District's R+10 partisan lean favors Sessions
Sessions holds a massive fundraising edge ($1.05M vs $9K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~5%
model.rationale: The R+10 district, Sessions' incumbency, and his overwhelming financial advantage ($934K on hand vs. $3K) make this a heavily Republican-leaning race with no evidence of a competitive challenge. Prediction markets and the absence of any expert rating or polling interest both point the same direction.
model.watch: Any late-breaking polling showing Shepard within single digits, or a surge of outside spending against Sessions, would be the first sign this is closer than expected.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-17 is a Republican-leaning district in central Texas, and incumbent Pete Sessions is seeking another term with the full advantages that come with it. Sessions has raised over $1 million and holds more than $930,000 in cash, while Democratic challenger Casey Shepard has raised under $9,000 with minimal cash on hand. No outside groups are opposing Sessions, and no independent polls of the race are available.

Prediction markets give Sessions roughly a 94% chance of winning, and no expert raters have flagged the contest as competitive. The district's partisan lean and the lopsided financial picture make an upset unlikely, though the lack of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
